gorsel_ozet: 1: Python kodu (GC=F, 01-01-2018 – 16-10-2024, EMA50/EMA200, Signal ve Position); 2: 'EMA Kesişimleri (50-200)' altın grafiği, AL (yeşil) ve SAT (kırmızı) işaretleri
kod_metni:
import pandas as pd
import yfinance as yf
from yahoo_fin.stock_info import *
import numpy as np
from mplfinance.original_flavor import candlestick_ohlc
import matplotlib.dates as mpl_dates
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

start = '01-01-2018'
end = '16-10-2024'

df = get_data('GC=F' , start , end).dropna()
df['Date'] = pd.to_datetime(df.index)
df['Date'] = df['Date'].apply(mpl_dates.date2num)
df = df.loc[:, ['Date' , 'open' , 'high' , 'low' , 'close' , 'volume']]
df.shape

# 50 günlük EMA
df['EMA_50'] = df['close'].ewm(span = 50 , adjust = False).mean()
# 200 günlük EMA
df['EMA_200'] = df['close'].ewm(span = 200 , adjust = False).mean()

# EMA50 > EMA200 1 ile işaretle
df['Signal'] =0
df['Signal'] = np.where(df['EMA_50'] > df['EMA_200'] , 1, 0 )
# Pizisyonlar
df['Position'] = df['Signal'].diff()

# Golden and Death Cross
plt.figure(figsize = (20 , 10))
df['close'].plot(color = 'skyblue' , lw = 3 , label = 'FİYAT')
df['EMA_50'].plot(color = 'darkorange' , lw = 2 , label = 'EMA_50')
df['EMA_200'].plot(color = 'black' , lw = 2 , label = 'EMA_200' , linestyle = '--')

plt.plot(df[df['Position'] == 1].index , df['EMA_50'][df['Position'] == 1] , '^' , markersize = 15 , color = 'g' , label = 'AL')
plt.plot(df[df['Position'] == -1].index , df['EMA_50'][df['Position'] == -1] , 'v' , markersize = 15 , color = 'r' , label = 'SAT')

plt.ylabel('USD Fiyat' , fontsize = 15)
plt.title('EMA Kesişimleri (50-200)' , fontsize = 20)
plt.legend()
plt.grid()
plt.show()
parametreler: EMA50 ve EMA200 (ewm span, adjust=False); Signal = 1 eğer EMA50 > EMA200; Position = Signal.diff(); +1 AL, -1 SAT; veri 01-01-2018 – 16-10-2024
